carrier_note: Draft JSON carrier; final adoption would require RISE-CBOR64-v1 per SS8 - but see verdict: this record does NOT establish negligibility and cannot enable chem_model=none predictive for wax.

denominator_construction.central: 12.6 lm (1 cd convention) / LER_vis(2000K)=113 lm/W_vis / 77W HRR = 1.45e-3 W/W
denominator_construction.inputs: Hamins 2005 HRR 77+-9W; Thomsen 2017 soot T 1900-2200K (PREVIEW-ONLY, abstract-verified); LER_vis computed 103-131 lm/W_vis over that T range
denominator_construction.route: luminous (the only lower-boundable route; chi_r routes cannot bound D_vis from below - soot-continuum share of chi_r unmeasured)

estimator: one-sided 95% upper bound on R = N_vis/D_vis; lognormal combination: R95 = R_central * exp(1.645*sqrt(sum sigma_ln^2)); numerator components additive at central values, sigma applied to total (conservative simplification, recorded)

extends_to.heptane: numerator machinery transfers (alkane); no lower-boundable denominator exists (dimmer visible output, no luminous convention) - bound would be WORSE than wax
extends_to.wood_volatiles: same; oxygenated volatiles add transfer uncertainty; TN 2327r1 gives chi_r but not a visible-band lower bound

interpretation: The visible blue base of a candle is real and sits at the percent level of the flame's visible output. chem_model=none is NOT certifiable for wax at the 1% threshold via any currently constructible bound - and plausibly not true at that threshold at all. Predictive wax likely requires an actual chem record (methane-record machinery, SS4.4) rather than a negligibility route. This does NOT relax SS7.0; it reports the measured/derived state of the world.
leg_ii_status: still blocked on SS12 item 4 regardless of leg (i)

C2_star_swan.central: = CH* central (Swan bands present in alkane blue bases at comparable strength; no measurement in Liu; qualitative candle spectroscopy only)

CH_star_431nm.ceiling_basis: peak rate over entire imaged half-space (pi*(10mm)^2*55mm)
CH_star_431nm.sheet_integration: annulus r=3mm, 1mm thick, 35mm tall = 6.6e-7 m3 at peak rate -> 2.0e-4 W

CO2_star_continuum.inputs: T=1950K; X_O=2.4e-3 (Liu Fig.8d simulated peak, 1.48e-8 mol/cm3); X_CO=0.05 central with 0.10 ceiling ([CO] peak NOT pinned in open literature - Mitchell 1980 and Smyth 1985 paywalled)
CO2_star_continuum.model: Slack & Grillo 1985 FULL-BAND rate I0 = 6.8e5*exp(-1960/T)*[CO][O] cm3/mol/s over 260-700nm (publisher abstract; NOTE the widely quoted 3.3e3*exp(-2300/T) form in Nori & Seitzman Eq.3 is the 375-nm-region rate, ~250x smaller - a materially important distinction)
CO2_star_continuum.volume: flame sheet x2 for post-flame CO+O recombination (Nori 2008: >= half of total signal possible)

OH_star_309nm.excluded: outside 380-780nm band (spectral truncation, exclusion is exact not approximate)

numerator_construction.anchor: Liu, Tan, Wan, Zhang & Yao 2020, ACS Omega 5:15922, DOI 10.1021/acsomega.0c01093 (open; ATTRIBUTION CORRECTED from 'Jin et al.'): integrating-sphere-calibrated, three-point-Abel-inverted volumetric photon emission rates for a laminar CH4 jet diffusion flame, case 2 (V_CH4 0.1885 L/min, 2mm nozzle, k_u=0.4); HRR = 103-112 W computed from stated flows (LHV 50 MJ/kg)

fuel_transfer_to_wax.basis: Orain & Hardalupas 2010 CRM 338:241 SS3.1.3: propane/isooctane chemiluminescence ~2x natural gas per unit fuel mass; heptane alkane-like (Marchese via O&H); NO absolute methane-to-liquid-fuel per-HRR factor exists in open literature (checked Nori 2007/2008)

results.sanity: 95% numerator (2.2e-4 W/W) < stacked hard ceilings (6.5e-4 W/W) < CTR-1994 premixed over-ceiling (2.5e-3): internally consistent

sensitivity.all_major_uncertainties_resolved: bound -> ~1.4% (central unchanged ~1%): the physics is genuinely marginal, not conservatism-stacking

results.verdict: CRITERION NOT MET. Even the central estimate sits at ~1%; the 95% bound is ~17x over.

tightening_paths_recorded: direct blue-continuum + C2* radiant-power measurement in an alkane diffusion flame (kills co2_model_form + completeness - the two largest terms)
measured candle visible-band radiometry (kills the 1-cd assumption)
author request to Liu et al. (NUDT) for the calibrated field data cubes (kills sheet_integration + digitization)

uncertainty_budget_sigma_ln.budget_classes_per_SS1.5a: measurement (liu_calibration, HRR), digitization (colorbar), geometry (sheet_integration, LER), spectral-truncation (OH* excluded exactly; CO2* counted fully - conservative), domain-transfer (fuel_transfer), model-form (co2_model_form, completeness, 1cd convention); covariance treated as zero (components independent by construction; recorded as a simplification)
